title: Bluegill Triple Prime led to Excalibur and SDI as a UFO-defense system
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bluegill Triple Prime led to Excalibur and SDI as a UFO-defense system, about 1962-1980s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there's a direct link between the Bluegill Triple Prime tests and Star Wars or the Strategic Defense Initiative that later took place in the8s.

uh fast forward to 1983, I think there's an argument that could be made that in the uh strategic defense initiative or Star Wars program under Ronald Reagan that the lethality and target hardening program or the particle beam weapons program were meant to be space-based systems that utilized microwave weaponry to to shoot down UFOs.
tellings.difference: Names the lethality and target hardening program and particle-beam or microwave weapons, and does not mention the Bluegill link.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim that Reagan's SDI was really meant as a system to shoot down UFOs.

as_told.title: Reagan-era SDI microwave weapons meant to shoot down UFOs
